objective_retained: At least three distinct, sufficiently innovative, verified improvements to global MiDrug AUC and AP, preserving LncDrug within 0.001. Do not reuse accepted directions.

mechanism_saturation.conclusion: The shared residual branch supplies a stable +0.0008/+0.001 over the strong reference; the inspected mechanism contributes zero-mean noise versus its own best control. No new message-passing mechanism can pass the mechanism gate on this data and protocol.

test_time_adaptation_triage.reason: No test-time-only information exists: the cross-fitting support graph is identical between training and inference, query labels are hidden, auxiliary relations are constant. TTA/TTT would duplicate training data and cannot add orthogonal signal.

next_research: Only new, orthogonal information can move the metric. Highest-value remaining direction is a drug-perturbation/response channel: cell-line drug response (GDSC/CCLE-style) cross-correlated with the already-present RNA x cell-line expression matrix, used as new pair evidence with a matched shuffled-entity control. This is data engineering first (entity mapping, coverage audit, label circularity check) before any model change. Graph-mechanism and test-time-adaptation families are closed for this data/protocol.
